columns.alien_template|signalprobabilities|signa: Unique signal reference ID, 36-char padded code.
columns.alien_template|signals|signalregistry: Unique signal registry ID, AS plus six digits padded to 36 chars.
columns.alien_template|signals|timemark: Timestamp with timezone offset +08; date and time to microseconds.
columns.alien_template|signals|telescref: Telescope reference code: T plus four digits, padded to 20 chars.
columns.alien_template|signals|sigstrdb: Signal strength in dB, negative values.
columns.alien_template|signals|freqdrifthzs: Frequency drift in Hz, can be negative.
columns.alien_template|signals|doppshifthz: Doppler shift in Hz, may be negative.
columns.alien_template|signals|interflvl: Interference level: Low, Medium, High; nullable.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|signalre: Unique identifier text, AS plus six digits.
columns.alien_template|sourceproperties|sourcera: Source right ascension in decimal degrees.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|s: Unique signal identifier: 'AS' plus six digits, padded to 36 chars.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|i: Categorical rating: Minimal, Moderate, or Severe.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|g: Gravitational lensing strength: Strong or Weak; nullable.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|q: Quantum effects indicator: Observed or Significant; nullable.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|e: Encryption evidence rating: Possible or Strong; nullable.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|l: Language structure category: Complex or Simple; nullable.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|m: Message content status: Identified or Possible; nullable.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|c: Cultural significance rating: High or Low; nullable.
columns.alien_template|signaladvancedphenomena|s: Scientific impact rating: Major, Moderate, or Minor.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|signalref: Unique signal reference ID; 36-character padded code.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|encodetype: Signal encoding type. Categorical: Binary, Tertiary, Complex, Unknown.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|errcorrlvl: Error correction level. Categorical: High, Medium, Low; 265 nulls.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|decodemeth: Decode method. Categorical: FFT, Wavelet, Neural Network, Quantum.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|decodestat: Decode status. Categorical: In Progress, Completed, Failed.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|proctimehr: Processing time in hours, real number.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|compresour: Computational resource level. Categorical: Low, Medium, High, Extreme.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|analysisdp: Analysis depth level. Categorical: Preliminary, Detailed, Comprehensive.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|veriflvl: Verification level. Categorical: Unverified, Partially, Verified.
columns.alien_template|signaldecoding|confirmsta: Confirmation status. Categorical: Rejected, Confirmed, Pending.
columns.alien_template|observatories|observstati: Observatory station identifier; 'Observatory-' plus place name.
columns.alien_template|observatories|weathprofil: Sky condition category: Clear, Cloudy, Partially Cloudy.
columns.alien_template|observatories|seeingprofi: Atmospheric seeing quality: Excellent, Good, Poor.
columns.alien_template|observatories|lunarstage: Moon phase: New, First Quarter, Full, Last Quarter.
columns.alien_template|observatories|solarstatus: Solar activity level: High, Moderate, Low.
columns.alien_template|observatories|siderealloc: Local sidereal time in hours, right-padded 8-char string.
columns.alien_template|observatories|windspeedms: Wind speed in meters per second.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|signalref: Unique signal identifier. Format 'AS' plus six digits.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigintegri: Signal integrity percentage. Numeric text, 0.2 to 99.9.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigrecurr: Signal recurrence type. Either 'Regular' or 'Sporadic'. May be NULL.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|tempstab: Temporal stability score. Numeric text, 0.001 to 0.999.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|spatstab: Spatial stability score. Numeric text, 0.003 to 0.999.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|freqstab: Frequency stability score. Numeric text, 0.0 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|phasestab: Phase stability score. Numeric text, 0.0 to 0.999.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|ampstab: Amplitude stability score. Numeric text, 0.001 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|modstab: Modulation stability score. Numeric text, 0.001 to 0.999.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigcoheren: Signal coherence score. Numeric text, 0.001 to 1.0.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigdisp: Signal dispersion value. Numeric text, 1.49 to 997.83.
columns.alien_template|signaldynamics|sigscint: Signal scintillation score. Numeric text, 0.002 to 0.999.
